title: Timezone Boundary Builder 2026e — simplified land time-zone regions
derivation: All 419 features from comprehensive land-only combined.json retained. Each geometry simplified with Shapely 2.1.2, tolerance 0.08 coordinate degrees, preserve_topology=True; coordinates rounded to four decimal places. No manual boundary editing. Derived data remains available under ODbL 1.0.
displayPolicy: The teaching view shows Beijing time across the mainland-China Asia/Shanghai polygon. The overlapping Asia/Urumqi regional-practice polygon is retained in the source data but omitted when painting, to avoid presenting UTC+06 as China's official standard time. This display choice is separate from the unmodified tzid features.
limitations: A community-maintained, simplified geographical illustration, not an authoritative legal boundary or coordinate-to-timezone lookup. Covers land time-zone regions; does not claim oceans all follow land civil time. Boundaries are a 2026e snapshot, not historical boundaries. Overlapping areas can exist in upstream data. Current UTC offsets and daylight-saving changes are computed separately through the browser Intl/IANA rules for the selected instant.
